name: NBA Injuries API
shortDescription: NBA injury reports with team and status filters, player ID lookup, name search, and snapshot freshness checks.
longDescription: Retrieve current NBA injury snapshots sourced from ESPN. Filter one or multiple teams by canonical or ESPN abbreviations, filter by normalized injury status, and find injured players by name or ESPN athlete ID. Discover all 30 supported teams. Responses preserve source status and include normalized status codes, estimated return dates, snapshot timestamps, and cache age/staleness indicators. A dedicated freshness endpoint reports old snapshots and repeated refresh failures. Snapshots refresh approximately every 120 seconds while running; source publication delays and idle startup latency apply. See the documentation and Python integration example for filters, error handling, aliases, and compatibility details.
